name: Siege Stack
storyline: The roads are overrun. Abdulrahman rides on the roof of a rolling tower of weapon floors and drives from lair to lair across ten worlds, from the City Boulevard to the Haunted Land, clearing out zombie hordes, giant beasts and their bosses, from the Zombie King to the Great Wyrm.
summary: Siege Stack is a tower defense game where your tower is a stack of weapon floors on wheels. Drive from lair to lair, stop at every door and hold the line while zombies and monsters pour out, pile on top of each other and climb toward Abdulrahman on the roof. Pick a weapon for every floor (gatling, flamethrower, buzzsaw, rockets, cryo jet, laser, tesla coil and more), merge identical floors into stronger ones, pick Workshop upgrades between waves and throw energy cards like meteor rain and missile storm. 1,000 levels across 10 worlds, 90 monsters from 30 lairs, 10 huge bosses, 57 floor weapons and 2,500 permanent upgrades.
